clips.title: The story
paras: Theldurin the Lost says Myzrael must be beaten while she is still growing, before her strength is enough to challenge those who hold her captive. At the Shards of Myzrael you call her forth, defeat her, and bind her Eldritch Shackles to the Shards.
Theldurin wants Myzrael stopped before her power swells enough to set her against her captors. Some claim she can be controlled; Theldurin asks why, then, the giants bothered to chain her at all.

You take the Scroll of Myzrael to the Shards, the place where you first talked with her, and call her up. After you defeat her, her Eldritch Shackles are yours to bind to the Shards, and she is trapped once more.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You must defeat Myzrael before she grows in strength. If you do not, then once she has gathered enough power she will challenge her captors! There are some who think they can control her, but if she can be controlled then why did the giants chain her in the first place??
To defeat her, summon her at the Shards of Myzrael where you first spoke with her. Defeat her and gather her Eldritch Shackles, then bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
Do that, and she will again be trapped.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Shards of Myzrael are now strangely quiet.

clips.title: Completion
paras: As the eldritch shackles are placed around the Shards, an unhuman wail is heard from far below. The scream is followed by a roar.
The Shards of Myzrael no longer invoke feelings of warmth and security as they once did. Now they pulse with an open menace... As if the thing beneath them holds ill will toward the surface.
